title: Term of Agreement (Kaplan Award 2025)
body: The Collective Agreement shall continue in full force and effect from February 1, 2024 to January 31, 2027.

title: Wage Increases (2024 - 2026)
body: Across-the-board wage increases awarded as follows: Effective February 1, 2024: 2.5%; Effective February 1, 2025: 2.0%; Effective February 1, 2026: 2.0%. Retroactivity to be paid within ninety (90) days from the date of award to current employees.

title: Paid Sick Days Entitlement (Award 2025)
body: Effective 90 days from the date of award, a Regular Part-Time Employee who has completed two (2) weeks of employment shall be entitled to two (2) paid sick days in any one (1) calendar year for absences due to illness, injury, or medical emergency.

title: Paid Sick Days - Non-Accumulation
body: Unused sick days shall not accumulate from year to year and shall be cancelled when the employment of a Regular Part-Time Employee ends for any reason.

title: Sick Pay Calculation
body: Sick pay is calculated based on a Regular Part-Time Employee's regular scheduled hours for that day.

title: Sick Days Set-Off Against ESA
body: Paid sick days pursuant to this Article include and are set off against the sick leave days to which an employee may be entitled pursuant to the Employment Standards Act, 2000.

title: Exclusive Bargaining Agent
body: The Union is recognized as the exclusive bargaining agent for all persons regularly employed for not more than 24 hours per week in office, clerical, technical, health care, maintenance, building service, shipping, transportation, cafeteria and nursery positions, and projects of a non-recurring kind.

title: Binding on the Parties
body: This Agreement is binding on the Council, Colleges, Union, and employees as defined in Article 1.1.

title: No Strikes and No Lockouts
body: The Union agrees there shall be no strike and the CEC agrees there shall be no lockout during the life of this Agreement, per the Colleges Collective Bargaining Act, 2008.

title: Regular Part-Time Employees
body: Regular Part-Time Employees are employees employed in a continuous position of indefinite extent with regularly scheduled hours on a weekly basis (up to 24 hours per week).

title: Casual Employees
body: Casual Employees are those who work on a call-in basis and/or do not have regularly scheduled hours on a weekly basis.

title: Temporary Employees
body: Temporary Employees are those employed to replace Regular Part-Time Employees on leave, or who are employed for a period of up to nine (9) consecutive months, or such longer period as the College and Local Union may agree.

title: Student Employees
body: Student Employees are students occupying positions that are only made available to current students of the College.

title: Project of a Non-Recurring Kind Employees
body: Project of a Non-Recurring Kind Employees are employees employed in projects of a non-recurring kind.

title: No Interference or Coercion
body: The Colleges and Union agree that there shall be no intimidation, discrimination, interference, restraint or coercion exercised or practised by either party based on union membership or non-membership.

title: Ontario Human Rights Code & Accommodation
body: No discrimination against any employee under the Ontario Human Rights Code. Accommodation, if requested and determined required, is the joint duty of the College, Union, and employee.

title: Management Rights
body: The Union acknowledges that it is the exclusive function of the Colleges to maintain order, discipline, efficiency, hire, discharge, transfer, classify, assign, promote, lay off, and direct operations, consistent with the Agreement.

title: List of Employees
body: The College shall provide a list of employees to the Local Union President in the second week of October, February, and June containing name, start date, department, rate of pay, location, employee type, and anticipated weekly hours.

title: Work of a Personal Nature
body: Employees shall not be required to do work of a personal nature unconnected with the operation of the College.

title: Union/College Committee
body: Creation of a Union/College Committee at each College consisting of up to three (3) Union representatives and up to three (3) Management representatives.

title: Union/College Committee Functions & EDI Agenda
body: The Union/College Committee shall meet 6 times per calendar year. Matters subject to local discussion include Employment Equity, Equity Diversity and Inclusion (EDI) programs, Indigenous Commitment, and mutually agreed items.

title: Workplace Sexual Harassment Protections
body: Right to be free from workplace sexual solicitation or advance. All colleges shall maintain a policy on workplace sexual harassment. Article 20 time limits do not apply provided complaint is made within a reasonable time. Union representation rights apply.

title: Bullying & Psychological Harassment
body: Protection against vexatious behavior that intimidates, degrades, humiliates, or affects dignity or integrity. Prompt confidential investigation with union representation rights.

title: Leaves Reimbursed by the Union
body: Paid leaves of absence granted for employees attending union conventions, seminars, Executive Board, or Divisional Executive meetings; Union reimburses College for all pay.

title: Leave for Union Representatives
body: Paid leaves granted for union representatives attending provincial meetings or EERC meetings; Union reimburses 50% of pay.

title: Union Negotiating Committee
body: Paid leave granted to up to 7 employees selected by the Union to negotiate collective agreement renewals; Union reimburses College for pay except direct bargaining days.

title: Full-Time Union Assignment Leave
body: Unpaid leave granted to up to two (2) employees elected to full-time union positions (2-year term). Employees accumulate full seniority during leave.

title: Union Dues Authorization
body: Deduction from regular pay of every bargaining unit employee of regular monthly union dues authorized under OPSEU by-laws.

title: Remittance of Union Dues
body: Deducted dues remitted to OPSEU Head Office by the 15th of the following month, accompanied by an alphabetical employee list with unique identifiers sent to the Local Union President.

title: Appointment of Stewards
body: Union right to select stewards from part-time employees who have completed probation to handle union business with the College.

title: Employee Orientation
body: Where a College has a formal orientation meeting for new part-time employees, the Local Union shall be given an opportunity to address the group.

title: Disciplinary Notice
body: Copy of formal disciplinary notice provided to employee. With employee consent, Local Union is notified that a discipline notice is served.

title: Access to Performance Appraisals / HR File
body: Employee entitled to reasonable access to official performance appraisals and disciplinary notices in their human resources file.

title: Removal of Discipline Notices from File
body: Employee may request once per calendar year removal of disciplinary notices in official HR file for more than 15 months (discretion not unreasonably exercised).

title: Hours of Work - General
body: Provides basis for calculating time worked (normally up to 24 hours per week). College open 7 days/week; weekend work may be required.

title: Request for Additional Hours
body: Regular Part-Time employees working under 24 hours/week may advise supervisor in writing each July 3rd of availability for additional hours.

title: Changes in Schedule
body: Regular Part-Time employees shall receive at least two (2) weeks' notice of schedule changes, except in circumstances beyond College control.

title: Canceled Shifts Pay Protection (Award 2025)
body: If the College cancels a Regular Part-Time Employee's shift with less than 24 hours' notice or sends them home early for reasons beyond their control, the employee suffers no loss of pay for that shift.

title: Overtime Rate
body: Authorized overtime paid at time and one-half (1.5x) hourly rate for hours worked in excess of 40 hours in each work week.

title: Rest & Meal Breaks
body: 30-minute unpaid meal break required after five (5) hours continuous work. Current rest period practices maintained.

title: Split Shifts
body: Employees not hired/posted into split shifts shall not be required to work split shifts without employee agreement.

title: On-Call Premium
body: Regular Part-Time assigned to on-call paid $1.00 per hour for on-call hours. Must be available and reachable to respond within reasonable time.

title: Call Back - Workplace Return
body: Regular Part-Time recalled to workplace before next shift guaranteed minimum payment of three (3) hours at regular rate.

title: Call Back - Off-site Resolution
body: Regular Part-Time recalled to resolve issues off-site (phone/remote) guaranteed minimum payment of two (2) hours.

title: Hourly Wages
body: Hourly rates determined by College, provided no employee paid less than minimum wage and scale includes general wage increases.

title: Pay Period
body: Employees paid every two (2) weeks. Overtime included in pay period following completion. First pay received within 4 weeks of hire.

title: Shift Premium
body: Shift premium of $0.75/hour for hours worked between 5 p.m. and midnight; $1.00/hour for hours worked between midnight and 6 a.m.

title: Kilometrage Allowance
body: Kilometrage allowance for authorized college business: 0-4000 km (40.0¢ South / 41.0¢ North per km); scaling down to 24.0¢/25.0¢ over 24,000 km.

title: Tuition Reimbursement
body: Regular Part-Time completing approved job-related educational courses reimbursed for all or part of tuition fees.

title: Tuition Fees ($20 Course Benefit)
body: Regular Part-Time employee may take approved college courses for $20 per course fee plus materials on own time (one course/term or as agreed).

title: Developmental Leave
body: Developmental leave of 1 to 12 months available to Regular Part-Time with 6+ years service for academic/technical skill enhancement.

title: Paid Statutory Holidays
body: Entitlement to Family Day, Good Friday, Victoria Day, Canada Day, Civic Holiday, Labour Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas Day, Dec 26, New Year's Day paid per ESA.

title: Working on Holidays
body: Authorized work on designated holiday paid at time and one-half (1.5x) for all hours worked PLUS statutory holiday pay entitlement.

title: Vacation Pay Entitlement & 6% Rate (Award 2025)
body: Vacation pay equal to 4% of earnings (< 5 yrs) and 6% (>= 5 yrs). Effective February 1, 2026: College pays 6% vacation pay to ALL employees. Paid each pay period.

title: Scheduling Vacation Time
body: Unpaid vacation preference submitted by March 1st; written approval/denial by March 15th. Requests not unreasonably denied.

title: Personal Leave Without Pay
body: Unpaid leave of absence may be granted by the College for legitimate personal reasons.

title: Bereavement Leave & Chosen Family (Award 2025)
body: Leave of 3 or more contiguous days without loss of pay granted on death of parent, spouse, child, sibling, parent-in-law, child-in-law, grandparent, chosen family, or guardian. 1 day paid leave for aunt, uncle, niece, nephew. Chosen family refers to non-biological kinship bonds.

title: Jury / Witness Duty
body: Regular Part-Time subpoenaed or called for jury duty paid difference between regular pay and jury fee received.

title: Citizenship Leave
body: Regular Part-Time granted paid leave up to maximum of two (2) shifts to attend proceedings to acquire Canadian Citizenship.

title: Pregnancy Leave
body: 17 weeks unpaid pregnancy leave per ESA for pregnant employees employed at least 13 weeks prior to expected delivery.

title: Parental Leave
body: 35 weeks (post-pregnancy) or 37 weeks (new parent) unpaid parental leave per ESA for employees employed at least 13 weeks.

title: Seniority Accumulation During Pregnancy/Parental Leave (Award 2025)
body: Employees on pregnancy or parental leave shall continue to accumulate seniority for the duration of their leaves.

title: Occupational Health & Safety Act
body: The parties acknowledge the statutory application of the Occupational Health and Safety Act.

title: Safety Footwear Reimbursement
body: Reimbursement up to $150.00 every two years upon proof of purchase for Regular Part-Time required to wear protective footwear.

title: Prescription Eye Protection Allowance
body: Reimbursement up to $20.00 annually for Regular Part-Time required to wear prescription eye protection.

title: Legislation Required Safety Equipment (Award 2025)
body: Where legislation requires specific safety equipment for an employee to perform duties, the College provides equipment at NO COST to employee.

title: Seniority Determination & Probation Period
body: Seniority is length of regular part-time service since hire date. Probationary period is 742 hours worked. Seniority lists published Oct, Feb, June.

title: Transfer Into Bargaining Unit Seniority Credit (Award 2025)
body: Accumulated college service outside bargaining unit credited toward seniority upon passing probation, unless interrupted by employment break >= 13 consecutive weeks.

title: Loss of Seniority
body: Seniority lost upon voluntary quit, discharge for cause, layoff > 12 months, overstaying leave, or unauthorized absence exceeding 5 working days.

title: Definition of Layoff
body: Regular Part-Time laid off if position eliminated or scheduled hours reduced by > 50% for more than 10 weeks in calendar year.

title: Notice of Layoff to Union
body: Written notice to Local Union prior to employee notice. Layoff meeting held within 7 days; no layoff implemented until 14 days after notice.

title: Notice of Layoff to Employee
body: Regular Part-Time completing probation receives minimum twenty-one (21) calendar days written notice of layoff.

title: Procedures for Layoff & Bumping
body: Layoff sequence: 1) Placed in vacant RPT position; 2) Bumps probationary employee; 3) Bumps most junior RPT in department; 4) Placed on recall list.

title: Recall List Rights
body: Laid-off RPT placed on recall list for 12 months. Recalled in order of seniority before hiring from open market.

title: Job Postings & Requesting PDF Copy (Award 2025)
body: Permanent vacancies posted internally for 5 days before outside hiring. Current employees may request copy of the most recent job posting of their position.

title: Job Competition Consideration
body: Successful applicant determined on qualifications, experience, and seniority. Seniority governs where qualifications and experience are relatively equal.

title: Vacancy Reoccurring Within 6 Months Exemption (Award 2025)
body: If successful applicant leaves position within 6 months, College may reconsider original internal interviewed applicants or repost.

title: Temporary Higher Wage Rate Assignment
body: RPT temporarily assigned higher-rated position duties for excess of 5 working days receives higher wage rate.

title: Consideration for Full-Time Unit Work
body: Where full-time support vacancies posted and no full-time applicant selected, part-time bargaining unit applicants given consideration.

title: Definition of Grievance
body: Grievance defined as written complaint arising from interpretation, application, administration, or alleged violation of Agreement.

title: Maintenance of Wages for Grievance Meetings
body: Grievor and Steward/Union Officer suffer no loss of pay when leaving duties during regular hours to attend grievance meetings.

title: Grievance Filing Timeline
body: Grievance must be presented within fifteen (15) days after circumstances giving rise to complaint occurred or ought reasonably to have come to attention.

title: Step 1 Grievance Procedure
body: Signed written grievance submitted to Department Head. Written decision provided within ten (10) days.

title: Step 2 Grievance Procedure
body: Appeal in writing within 10 days to HR Director. Meeting convened within 14 days; written decision given within 10 days following meeting.

title: Group Grievances
body: Identical grievances across multiple employees processed directly at Step 2 signed by each affected employee.

title: Union Policy Grievance
body: Union right to file policy grievance on direct differences with College within 30 days, processed at Step 2.

title: Referral to Mediation / Arbitration
body: Unsettled grievances referred to Mediation/Arbitration by written notice given within ten (10) days of Step 2 decision.

title: Student Employee Rights & Interview Feedback (Award 2025)
body: Student employees covered by Human Rights, Harassment, Union Matters, Overtime, Wages, Holidays, Vacation Pay, Bereavement, and Health & Safety. Interviewed student applicants may request application feedback within 5 days.

title: Temporary Employee Rights
body: Temporary employees covered by Human Rights, Harassment, Union Matters, Overtime, Wages, Shift Premium, Holidays, Vacation Pay, Bereavement, and Health & Safety.

title: Casual Employee Rights
body: Casual employees covered by Human Rights, Harassment, Union Matters, Overtime, Wages, Holidays, Vacation Pay, Bereavement, and Health & Safety.

title: Indigenous Commitment Letter of Understanding (Award 2025)
body: Shared commitment to removing employment barriers for Indigenous peoples and acknowledging traditional territories. Discussed at Union/College Committee and shared annually with EERC.

title: Commitment to Equity, Diversity, and Inclusivity (Award 2025)
body: Shared commitment to promoting a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace. Strategies, training, and initiatives discussed at Union/College Committee and reported annually to EERC.
